summary: This bill automatically continues government funding at 99% of the previous year's level, with a 1% reduction every 30 days, if Congress fails to pass appropriations bills on time, thereby preventing government shutdowns.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly addresses government spending by establishing automatic continuing appropriations at a reduced rate if regular appropriations are not enacted. This mechanism aims to prevent government shutdowns but also mandates a reduction in spending over time if new appropriations are delayed, thus pushing towards less government spending in such scenarios.

By mandating a reduction in the rate of operations for government programs if appropriations are not passed, the bill inherently promotes fiscal restraint and could lead to lower government expenditures in the absence of new spending bills. This indirectly supports prioritizing debt reduction by limiting potential deficit spending during funding impasses.
